en: Prix Ars Electronica: Hybrid Art & AI and Life Art
zh: 电子艺术大奖：混合艺术与人工智能及生命艺术
desc_en: Golden Nicas, Awards of Distinction and Honorary Mentions of the Prix Ars Electronica Hybrid Art category (2007–2017) and its successor Artificial Intelligence & Life Art / Artificial Life & Intelligence (2019–2025) that work with living organisms.
desc_zh: 电子艺术大奖（Prix Ars Electronica）“混合艺术”类别（2007–2017）及其后继类别“人工智能与生命艺术 / 人工生命与智能”（2019–2025）中与活体生物合作的金尼卡奖、优异奖和荣誉提名作品。
